notes.title: Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi Update 1.022 is Here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

[b]The update for Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi is here[/b]! Your continuous support and feedback have been invaluable to the Marslit brothers as they continue to improve the game. We deeply appreciate it!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Adjustments, balancing, and improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Toggle to use Raw Mouse Input for Camera Movement.
[*] The Pause screen now opens the map and not the inventory, making navigation smoother.
[*] Balanced the mana consumption of the great sword.
[*] Rebalanced life and mana gain from powerups.
[*] Audio balance improved.
[*] Improved menu navigation experience.
[*] You can now navigate menus using a mouse.
[*] Added accessibility settings for increasing font size.
[*] Music now fades instead of stops abruptly.
[*] Added post-game exploration.
[*] Improved performance near the harbor to the shrine
[*] Improved text readability on the Steam Deck, it should be about 20% larger now on bigger screens.
[*] Improved puzzle onboarding for the Temple of Life.
[*] Removed the two red circles from the lamps so players stop mistaking them for targets.
[*] Main menu language selection now asks you to confirm first before you switch.
[*] Improved performance in the Shrine of Life
[*] Improved performance in the Shrine of Death
[*] Improved performance in Temple of Life
[*] Improved performance in Temple of Death
[*] Improved performance in the Mine
[*] Improved performance in Stasi
[*] Improved performance in the Tower.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed displaying the wrong language in some tutorials or quests.
[*] Fixed issue with mana recovery on enemy drop.
[*] Fixed issue where mana could not recover or be spent.
[*] Fixed a progression blocker when you first meet the Automata.
[*] Fixed Fountain Collision for the first and second fountains.
[*] Fixed shortcut collision.
[*] Fixed a performance issue near the shrine harbor.
[*] Fixed a tutorial display issue.
[*] Fixed a door preventing attacks in the overworld.
[*] Fixed tutorial visualization for the tutorial battle.
[*] Fixed saving issue inside the Shrine of Life.
[*] Fixed wrong rotation for map icons.
[*] Fixed the Atma not following you in the Temple of Death.
[*] Fixed void collisions for the First and Second Altar.
[*] Fixed collision near the blacksmith's cart. 
[*] Fixed saving camera settings. No need to adjust it every time now! 
[*] Fixed falling out of the world when swimming under Aria’s house.
[*] Fixed falling out of the world near the final harbor.
[*] Fixed sometimes not being able to resurface from swimming.
[*] Fixed infinite sphere glitch inside the Shrine of Death.
[*] Fixed collision issue in the final boss fight.
[*] Fixed wrong range visualization for multi arrow targets.
[*] Fixed the special attack disabling normal attacks.
[*] Fixed Fall damage not applying after some combination of rolling and climbing.
[*] Fixed falling animation sometimes not playing.
[*] Fixed Sadi's unintended doppleganger appearing during the falling cutscene inside the Mine.
[*] Fixed beast interaction in the overworld
[*] Fixed a bug that would hide the Y button when interacting with Void corruption.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing you to skip the puzzle to the Temple of Death.
[*] Fixed a UI bug in the second overworld when completing the multi arrow puzzle.
[*] Fixed a bug caused by holding a sphere and swimming.
[*] Fixed a bug caused by holding a sphere and falling.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed Lili to grab spheres while holding the bomb
[*] Fixed multiple bugs related to the Shrine of Death and push boxes
[*] Fixed corruption bomb IK
[*] Fixed respawn issue in the Shrine of Death
[*] Fixed haptic feedback playing on controller even when using a mouse and keyboard
[*] Fixed some dialog not playing their voice over
[/list]

Thank you again for your support! Please keep those reports coming, every piece of feedback helps the team improve the game.

notes.title: Devlog #1: Lili and Sadi🍃
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, adventurers!

Now that Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi is released, we would like to introduce you to both of our protagonists : Lili and Sadi in our first ever devlog!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40672354/50dbfa772fb5a62264a8fb7efcc7b34fd8a3d600.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]⚔️[b]Starting off with our reluctant Guardian, Lili![/b]⚔️[/h3][p]Lili's story begins in Atarassia's peaceful ancient forests. Raised by her loving mother, she knew only the company of spirits, ethereal beings native to Atarassia. This isolated upbringing shaped her into someone who found solace in solitude, as she never connected with other humans. [/p][p]Like her mother, Lili was being trained to be a Guardian: a protector of Atarassia. Guardians have a duty to ensure the safety of Atarassia's spirits. Though Guardians are trained in many weapons, Lili’s chosen weapon is her mother’s sword. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40672354/084cbadae11544624eea87a9b6d1da8f43f001f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Her life changed when Aferi emerged from the shadows. Her mother, who was a sworn Guardian, fought against him and lost her life in the process. The loss of her mother has left her with no desire to save anyone. She no longer wishes to be a Guardian, nor to be hailed as a hero. But if the world can ever hope to be saved, she must take on this role.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40672354/b8f61842396c0d81bceed51dfc674b35e94a135b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To fulfill her responsibilities to Atarassia, Lili must make peace with her own grief. She believes that she’s responsible for her mother’s death, so why should she become a Guardian? Any further involvement would just make things worse... Right? At least, that's what she believed.  It is only through Sadi's insistence that Lili decides to take on the journey of a Guardian, and while she won't be able to bring her mother back... [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40672354/8b474a509da2ea286aef24cdbe38fafd6d2ed8cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]She will learn what it means for the world to rely on her, and for her to rely on others.  [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🤜[b]Next up, our Monk-in-training Sadi![/b]🤛[/h3][p]Sadi, like all the other monks in Atarassia, grew up in the Monastery, where monks dedicate their lives to understanding the world's deepest mysteries. Here, he immersed himself in both the creative and arcane arts, spending countless hours studying the history of Atarassia through sacred scriptures that hold the secrets of ages past. His training led him to emphasize on patience, care, and the bond between souls.

While Guardians serve as Atarassia's protectors, Monks are its caretakers. Their sacred duties involve tending to the spirits and safeguarding the Sap that flows through all living beings. Together, these two roles form partnerships designed to protect the world against the Void.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40672354/942d5b1b1eee4c7b3296b755b17243f75d76814a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Sadi embodied these teachings perhaps too well. His unwavering dedication to his responsibilities, combined with his naturally uptight attitude, created a barrier between him and potential friendships. While other monks found balance between duty and connection, Sadi chose isolation, believing that "duty over desires" was the only path worth walking. This philosophy would prove to be both his greatest strength and his biggest weakness.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40672354/6105dd4577bf2ab0adaac8df06b7569f40848c83.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When Aferi appeared, the monks tried to fight him but were overcame by his devastating power. The Monastery suffered heavy casualties, leaving only Sadi as the sole survivor. Just like Lili, he blames himself for failing to save his fellow monks from Aferi's attack, wracked by survivor's guilt. He often questions his worth, if a failure like him can truly become a proper guide for a Guardian... [/p][p][/p][p]Throughout their journey, Sadi must overcome his shame, grow in confidence, and eventually realize he has his own wishes for his life beyond his responsibilities.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40672354/4e925dee2c0e52ddd03aad217674605035ab360c.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Now that you're finished reading, what did you think of our heroes? Saving the world is no easy feat, it's why it's important for them to work together to restore the world of Atarassia!  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Take on Lili and Sadi's journey in Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi! Get it now for 10% OFF:[/b]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638160/Altheia_The_Wrath_of_Aferi/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
Don't forget to join our [i][u][url="https://discord.gg/nd"]community[/url][/u][/i] and follow our [i][u][url="https://neondoctrine.games/m/links"]socials[/url][/u][/i]!

[/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is Here — We Brought the Demo, You Bring the Snacks.
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! [/p][h3]It’s that magical time of year again—[b]Steam Next Fest is live, and Neon Doctrine is thrilled to be part of it![/b][/h3][p]
This year, we’re shining the spotlight on something truly special. Created by two real-life brothers over the span of years, a heartfelt fantasy adventure about grief, healing, and growing into who you were meant to be...

Presenting to you,

[b]🍃Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi🍃[/b] [/p][previewyoutube="9lJAyoXGxgs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Inspired by Zelda, Studio Ghibli, and those touching moments that hit you right in the feels, Altheia blends puzzle-solving, light combat, and exploration into a cozy-yet-epic journey through a world touched by magic, and loss. 

You’ll play as Lili, a reluctant Guardian who wants nothing to do with her mother’s legacy, and Sadi, a Monk-in-training determined to save their homeland from a creeping corruption known as the Void. Together, they must explore ancient ruins, unlock clever dungeon puzzles, and face monsters born from shadow and sorrow.
